motto: All people, all paces, all welcome.
routeNote: The route changes every week. A few favourites come round again, but never more than twice a month.

lightsNotice.title: Bring A Light
lightsNotice.text: Now the nights are drawing in, everyone needs a light on a run. A head torch, a reflective running vest with lights, or any other light so drivers and other runners can see you.
